program='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rectangles = []

    # For each row interval, find maximal horizontal runs that are constant
    # across every row in the interval. Keep only runs that cannot extend
    # vertically without changing a cell.
    for top in range(rows):
        for bottom in range(top + 3, rows):
            c = 0
            while c < cols:
                color = grid[top][c]
                end = c
                while end + 1 < cols and all(grid[r][end + 1] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1)):
                    end += 1
                if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1)):
                    width = end - c + 1
                    height = bottom - top + 1
                    if width >= 4:
                        can_extend_up = top > 0 and all(grid[top - 1][j] == color for j in range(c, end + 1))
                        can_extend_down = bottom + 1 < rows and all(grid[bottom + 1][j] == color for j in range(c, end + 1))
                        if not can_extend_up and not can_extend_down:
                            rectangles.append((top, bottom, c, end))
                    c = end + 1
                else:
                    c += 1

    for top, bottom, left, right in rectangles:
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
